segments.name: Beverages
products: Rip It energy drinks and shots
segments.description: Develops, produces, markets and sells sparkling waters, juices, energy drinks and carbonated soft drinks primarily in the United States.
segments.evidence: The Company operates as a single operating and reportable segment that encompasses the development, production, marketing and sale of beverages.

revenueModel.text: The company earns net sales from retailers and distributors, including national retailers, grocery stores, club stores, mass-merchandisers, wholesalers and food-service customers, who purchase its beverages.
revenueModel.evidence: To service a diverse customer base that includes numerous national retailers, as well as thousands of smaller "up-and-down-the-street" accounts, we utilize a hybrid distribution system to deliver our products through three primary distribution channels: take-home, convenience and food-service.
